orig: Wallace and Gromit in The Wrong Trousers
ov: البنطال الخطأ (الإنجليزية: The Wrong Trousers) فيلم ستوب موشن قصير، صدر عام 1993، من إخراج وتأليف نيك بارك. حصل الفيلم على جائزة الأوسكار لأفضل فيلم رسوم متحركة قصير عام 1994، كما حصل على عشرة جوائز عالمية أخرى. يتمتع الفيلم بتقييم عالي على موقع قاعدة بيانات الأفلام على الإنترنت، وموقع الطماطم الفاسدة لتقييم الأفلام. الفيلم هو الثاني في سلسلة أفلام كوميدية تحكي مغامرات الكلب غروميت وصديقه والاس.
plotEn:
Wallace gifts his dog, Gromit, a pair of robotic "Techno-Trousers" for his birthday to take him on walks, to his irritation. To pay his debts, Wallace rents a room to a penguin, who befriends Wallace and drives Gromit out of the house. The penguin takes an interest in the trousers, which can walk on walls and ceilings, and secretly rewires them for remote control. Gromit discovers that the penguin is Feathers McGraw, a criminal who disguises himself as a chicken by wearing a rubber glove on his head.
Feathers forces Wallace into the trousers and sends him through town to tire him out and then to bed. Gromit spies on Feathers as he takes measurements of the local museum and discovers his plot to steal a very rare diamond. While Wallace is asleep, Feathers marches him to the museum in the trousers. He infiltrates the building and steals the diamond, but triggers the alarm, waking Wallace up. Feathers marches him back to the house and traps him and Gromit in a wardrobe at gunpoint. After Gromit rewires the Techno-Trousers to break open the wardrobe, he and Wallace pursue Feathers aboard their model train set. Wallace disarms Feathers and frees himself from the trousers. After Feathers' train collides with the trousers, Gromit subdues him.
Feathers is turned in to the police and incarcerated at the local zoo as Wallace pays his debts with the reward money. As Wallace and Gromit relax, the discarded Techno-Trousers reactivate in a dustbin outside and walk off into the sunset.
